name: audio_extract
description: Save the audio of a video (or convert an audio file) as mp3 (default), m4a, wav, flac, opus or ogg, optionally only between start and end. Use wav for speech-to-text tools, mp3 for sharing.

input.description: Path of the audio or video file, relative to the workspace.

format.description: mp3 (default), m4a, wav, flac, opus or ogg. The output extension wins if given.

bitrate.description: Bitrate for lossy formats, such as 128k, 192k (default) or 320k.

start.description: Start of the section. Default the beginning. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

end.description: End of the section. Default the end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_audio.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
